topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out about the building going condo, and I should have seen it coming, really. There were signs—little things here and there, whispers in the hall. I’m worried about how this will affect everyone, especially those who might struggle with the change. It’s not just a home; it’s where people have built their lives. I wish I had spoken up sooner, tried to gather everyone, maybe even looked into what we could have done to prevent this. Now, it feels like it’s too late, and I can only hope that somehow, we’ll all find a way to make the best of it.
